_readme: Curated job boards for design work. Every URL is checked by src/boards.js before it ships; anything that 404s or fails to resolve is dropped at embed time. `focus` drives the discipline filter: uiux, graphic, branding, general. `region` groups the list.

boards.name: Dribbble Jobs
boards.note: The default for visual and brand work. Portfolio-led — your Dribbble profile is the application.

boards.name: Behance JobList
boards.note: Adobe's board. Strongest for graphic, motion and brand roles.

boards.name: UX Jobs Board
boards.note: Pure UX/product design, curated, global with heavy remote listings.

boards.name: Coroflot
boards.note: Long-running design board; strong in industrial and brand design.

boards.name: AIGA Design Jobs
boards.note: The US professional design association's board. Graphic and brand heavy.

boards.name: IxDA Job Board
boards.note: Interaction Design Association. Interaction and research roles.

boards.name: Awwwards Jobs
boards.note: Agency and studio work, digital/web design led.

boards.name: Smashing Jobs
boards.note: Front-end and UX crossover; small but high quality.

boards.name: Working Not Working
boards.note: Curated creative talent network — agencies and brand studios hire here.

boards.name: Creativepool
boards.note: Creative industry network, UK-rooted but global listings.

boards.name: Krop
boards.note: Creative and tech portfolio board.

boards.name: The Design Kids
boards.note: Built for design students and graduates. Studio listings by city worldwide.

boards.name: We Work Remotely — Design
boards.note: One of the largest remote boards; design is a top-level category.

boards.name: RemoteOK — Design
boards.note: Also read automatically by your search agent.

boards.name: Remotive — Design
boards.note: Also read automatically by your search agent.

boards.name: Jobicy — Design
boards.note: Also read automatically by your search agent.

boards.name: Himalayas — Design
boards.note: Remote board with good filtering by timezone and country eligibility.

boards.name: JustRemote
boards.note: Remote design listings; some behind a paid tier.

boards.name: Working Nomads — Design
boards.note: Curated remote listings, daily digest by email.

boards.name: Wellfound
boards.note: Formerly AngelList Talent. Startup roles, salary and equity shown up front.

boards.name: Y Combinator — Work at a Startup
boards.note: YC portfolio only. Small teams, early design hires.

boards.name: Built In
boards.note: US tech-hub focused with a real design category.

boards.name: Otta / Welcome to the Jungle
boards.note: Otta merged into Welcome to the Jungle. Strong UK and France coverage, good matching.

boards.name: LinkedIn Jobs
boards.note: Largest volume anywhere. Set alerts for exact titles rather than browsing.

boards.name: Glassdoor
boards.note: Listings plus salary and interview reports — useful before you apply.

boards.name: Design Jobs Board
boards.note: The UK design board. Studios, agencies and in-house teams.

boards.name: The Dots
boards.note: UK creative network — portfolio profile doubles as your application.

boards.name: Design Week Jobs
boards.note: Industry publication's board. Senior and studio-side brand roles.

boards.name: Creative Boom Jobs
boards.note: UK creative industry listings, often smaller studios.

boards.name: Reed
boards.note: Large UK generalist board with a design category.

boards.name: Totaljobs
boards.note: UK generalist; good for in-house and agency roles outside London.

boards.name: IrishJobs
boards.note: The main Irish board — Dublin has a large tech design market.

boards.name: If You Could Jobs
boards.note: UK creative jobs board. Studios, brand agencies and cultural institutions.

boards.name: Creative Lives in Progress
boards.note: Early-career creative opportunities — internships, placements and junior roles, UK-focused.

boards.name: Dasauge
boards.note: The German creative industry board. Agencies, studios, in-house. German-language.

boards.name: StepStone
boards.note: Germany's largest job board. German-language, huge volume.

boards.name: XING Jobs
boards.note: The German-speaking professional network — LinkedIn's local equivalent.

boards.name: Berlin Startup Jobs
boards.note: Berlin startup scene, mostly English-speaking roles — good if you have no German.

boards.name: German Tech Jobs
boards.note: English-language tech roles in Germany, salary ranges shown.

boards.name: Welcome to the Jungle France
boards.note: The dominant French tech and creative board.

boards.name: APEC
boards.note: France's board for cadres — professional and managerial roles. French-language.

boards.name: France Travail
boards.note: The national employment service, formerly Pôle emploi. French-language.

boards.name: Creativeheads
boards.note: The Dutch creative industry board. Agencies and design studios. Dutch-language.

boards.name: Magnet.me
boards.note: Dutch graduate and early-career platform — strong for internships.

boards.name: Nationale Vacaturebank
boards.note: Large Dutch generalist board. Dutch-language.

boards.name: Undutchables
boards.note: Recruiter for international, non-Dutch-speaking candidates in the Netherlands.

boards.name: Domestika Jobs
boards.note: Spanish-founded creative community with a design-only board. Spain and Latin America.

boards.name: InfoJobs
boards.note: Spain's largest job board. Spanish-language.

boards.name: Landing.jobs
boards.note: Portuguese-founded tech board covering Portugal, Spain and remote EU. English-language.

boards.name: Net-Empregos
boards.note: Portugal's main generalist board. Portuguese-language.

boards.name: InfoJobs Italia
boards.note: Large Italian generalist board. Italian-language.

boards.name: Monster Italia
boards.note: Italian arm of Monster; design roles under creative categories.

boards.name: Indeed Italia
boards.note: Highest listing volume in Italy; aggregates most other boards.

boards.name: The Hub
boards.note: Nordic startup jobs — Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland. English-language.

boards.name: Jobindex
boards.note: Denmark's largest board. Danish-language.

boards.name: Arbetsförmedlingen
boards.note: Sweden's national employment service job bank. Swedish-language.

boards.name: Finn.no Jobb
boards.note: Norway's dominant classifieds site — where most Norwegian jobs are posted. Norwegian-language.

boards.name: Duunitori
boards.note: Finland's largest job board. Finnish-language.

boards.name: No Fluff Jobs
boards.note: Salary always disclosed. Poland plus wider CEE. English-language.

boards.name: JustJoin.IT
boards.note: Polish tech board with a UX/UI category and open salary ranges.

boards.name: Pracuj.pl
boards.note: Poland's largest generalist board. Polish-language.

boards.name: Jobs.cz
boards.note: The main Czech board. Czech-language.

boards.name: StartupJobs.cz
boards.note: Czech and Slovak startup roles, often English-speaking.

boards.name: jobs.ch
boards.note: Switzerland's largest board, with an English interface.

boards.name: jobup.ch
boards.note: French-speaking Switzerland — Geneva and Lausanne.

boards.name: karriere.at
boards.note: Austria's largest job board. German-language.

boards.name: Jobat
boards.note: Belgian board covering both Dutch and French-speaking regions.

boards.name: StepStone Belgium
boards.note: Belgian arm of StepStone, trilingual listings.

boards.name: eJobs
boards.note: Romania's largest board. Romanian-language.

boards.name: Kariera.gr
boards.note: Greece's main job board.

boards.name: MojPosao
boards.note: Croatia's main job board. Croatian-language.
